The *Bhāvanāyapahātabbahetukaduka* is an Abhidhamma treatise forming section 8.60 of the *Paṭṭhāna* [SuttaCentral]. It applies the Paṭṭhāna's system of conditional relations (*paccaya*) to the dyad (*duka*) concerning phenomena with root causes that are to be abandoned by mental cultivation (*bhāvanā*) [SuttaCentral].

Other close textual partners include the *Piṭṭhiduka* (Patthana 2.13), the *Bhāvanāyapahātabbaduka* (Patthana 8.58), and another conditional treatment of the same dyad at Patthana 14.29 [DharmaNexus]. No cross-language matches with Chinese, Sanskrit, or Tibetan corpora are recorded at or above the threshold score of 10 [DharmaNexus].
